ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rectangle, point $E$ is on the extension of segment $CB$, connecting $DE$ intersects $AB$ at point $F$, $\angle AED = 2\angle DEC$, $G$ is the midpoint of $DF$, if $BE=1, DF=8$, then what is the length of $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral $ABCD$ is a rectangle,\\
it follows that $\angle ABC=\angle BAD=90^\circ$, $AD\parallel BC$,\\
therefore, $\angle ADG=\angle DEC$,\\
since G is the midpoint of $DF$ and $DF=8$,\\
it follows that AG=FG=DG=4,\\
thus, $\angle GAD=\angle GDA=\angle DEC$,\\
since $\angle AGE=\angle GAD+\angle GDA=2\angle DEC$ and $\angle AED=2\angle DEC$,\\
it follows that $\angle AEG=\angle AGE$,\\
therefore, AE=AG=4,\\
in right triangle $ABE$,\\
$AB=\sqrt{AE^{2}-EB^{2}}=\sqrt{4^{2}-1^{2}}=\sqrt{15}$.\\
Therefore, $AB=\boxed{\sqrt{15}}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure ABCD is a rectangle, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left, D is at the upper right, and C is at the lower right, so AD and BC are horizontally parallel, and AB is perpendicular to AD. E is on the leftward extension line of CB, so E, B, C are collinear. Line DE starts from E and passes through F on AB, then passes through the middle point G to D, so E, F, G, D are collinear; AE and AG are also connected in the figure. Reasoning: Let θ=∠DEC. Because AD∥EC, and DG and DE are on the same straight line, ∠ADG=∠DEC=θ. Also because F is on AB and AB⊥AD, triangle ADF is a right triangle, with DF as the hypotenuse. G is the midpoint of DF and DF=8, so the midpoint of the hypotenuse is equidistant from the three vertices, AG=DG=FG=DF/2=4. Thus in triangle ADG, AG=DG, so ∠GAD=∠GDA=θ. Since GE is the opposite extension line of GD, ∠AGE is the exterior angle of triangle ADG at G, so ∠AGE=∠GAD+∠ADG=2θ. The problem states ∠AED=2∠DEC=2θ, and ED and EG are on the same line, so ∠AEG=∠AED=2θ. Therefore ∠AEG=∠AGE, triangle AEG is isosceles, and AE=AG=4. Finally, in right triangle ABE, BE=1 and AE=4, so AB=√(AE^2-BE^2)=√(16-1)=√15.
